"""Plain text absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.attendance import days_missed


def _absent_days(student: Student, marks: List[Mark]):
    if any(m.student_id != student.student_id for m in marks):
        raise ProjectError("marks for another student")
    days = days_missed(marks)
    if not days:
        raise ProjectError("no absences to report")
    return days


# ---
def absence_notice(
    student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]
) -> str:
    """Short notice naming the student and absent days."""
    days = _absent_days(student, list(marks))
    when = ", ".join(day.isoformat() for day in days)
    name = f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name}"
    return f"{name} missed {len(days)} day(s): {when}."
EOF

import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Doe", "Jane", "A")


def mark(day, status="absent", who="s1"):
    return Mark(who, date(2026, 1, day), status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_dates_in_order(self):
        marks = [mark(9), mark(5), mark(6, "present")]
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertEqual(
            text,
            "Jane Doe missed 2 day(s): "
            "2026-01-05, 2026-01-09.",
        )

    def test_other_student_rejected(self):
        marks = [mark(5), mark(6, who="s2")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, [mark(5, "late")])
EOF
